mapper.select: select ct.id, ct.clinic_id as orgId, btbtc.tariffCategoryId, btbtc.tariffCategoryName, btbtc.tariffCategoryNumber, btbtc.tariffId, btbtc.`name`, btbtc.englishName, btbtc.`number`, btbtc.unit, ct.price, ct.inservice from clinic_tariff ct left join ( select bt.id as tariffId, btc.id as tariffCategoryId, btc.`name` as tariffCategoryName, btc.number as tariffCategoryNumber, bt.item_number as number, bt.`name`, bt.english_name as englishName, bt.unit from base_tariff bt left join base_tariff_category btc on bt.tariff_category_id = btc.id ) btbtc on ct.tariff_id = btbtc.tariffId where ct.clinic_id = #{orgId} and btbtc.tariffId = #{tariffId}

SELECT btc.id as categoryId, btc.NAME as categoryName, btc.number as categoryNumber, bt.id, bt.item_number, bt.name, bt.unit, bt.pinyin, bt.price FROM base_tariff_category btc LEFT JOIN base_tariff bt ON bt.tariff_category_id = btc.id
CASE #{search} REGEXP "^[A-Za-z]+$" WHEN 1 THEN bt.pinyin = #{search} ELSE bt.name like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') END

SELECT btc.id as categoryId, btc.`name` as categoryName, btc.number as categoryNumber, bt.id, bt.item_number, bt.`name`, bt.unit, bt.pinyin, bt.price FROM base_oral_tariff_category btc LEFT JOIN base_oral_tariff bt ON bt.oral_tariff_category_id = btc.id
CASE #{search} REGEXP "^[A-Za-z]+$" WHEN 1 THEN bt.pinyin = #{search} ELSE bt.name like CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') END
